_note: Pages are set by hand, from the 2026-11-05 audit. A sweep must not restore anything listed in `deleted`, must not create a landing page where `landing` already points, and must not overwrite `landing` or `app`.
landing_note: No landing page by design. The dashboard is a single-user tool: the app at docs/play/ is the entry point and there is nothing to introduce. A sweep must not create one.
